explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows pantoprazole sodium posted 2019-05-28 and still listed as of 2026-10-21; the rule-based best option is Avenacy, LLC, whose label names no plant we could place

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows pantoprazole sodium was posted on 2019-05-28 and remained on the list as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 89 months.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Avenacy, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Avenacy, LLC's label names no plant we could place, so the manufacturing site cannot be verified from the label.

Other alternate manufacturers ranked by the rule include BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Baxter Healthcare Company, also not on FDA's shortage list today and with labels that name no plant we could place.
Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 16 days on hand at Corvale East, 19 days at Corvale General, and 19 days at Corvale Lakeside.
Because the links are weak or some records fail data checks, verify Avenacy, LLC's current supply availability and confirm the manufacturing site before purchasing.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-972f03.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-2f7116.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%pantoprazole%' ORDER BY first_posting
